metadata.description: gon2gon2's agent skills, packaged as plugins.

plugins.name: orca-workflows
plugins.description: Workflows that run coding agents through Orca. rather-than-me sends one brief to frontier models made by other AI labs, collects their independent reviews and compares them with its own view. issue-autopilot sets up a scheduled Orca automation that implements a repo's GitHub issues one at a time from a runbook, each in a fresh worktree ending in a PR. Works from Claude Code and Codex. Requires Orca.

plugins.name: dev-practices
plugins.description: Practices for building agent skills. deterministic-sandwich moves every deterministic step of a skill into a script so the LLM makes exactly one natural-language judgment.
